summary: Brookfield Private Equity Fund LP filed an 8-K reporting an unregistered sale of limited partnership units for aggregate consideration of approximately $4.5 million on June 1, 2026, with transactional NAV per unit disclosed as of May 31, 2026. The sale was part of the Fund's continuous private offering under Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation D, with Class S and I units sold to third-party investors, including through a tax-feeder fund, and Class B-2 units to Brookfield affiliates. The filing also noted that the broader BPE Program has sold interests for ~$332 million since November 1, 2025. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation, with no change of control or strategic event.
